## Waterfall.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `items` :: Hierarchical trace spans rendered as indented timeline rows.
- `markers` :: Vertical reference timestamps overlaid across lanes (e.g. LCP, FCP).
- `selectedId` :: Active selected span id; bindable.
- `onSelect` :: Called when a user selects a span row.
- `unit` :: Display unit suffix appended to axis ticks and duration labels.
- `ticks` :: Number of evenly spaced axis ticks.
- `surface` :: The surface the whole waterfall sits on: fill, border and shadow in one choice.
- `shape` :: The corner treatment of that surface.
- `size` :: The height of the caret and spacer squares in the tree column.
- `textSize` :: The scale of the span labels.
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the axis header, the status note and the duration column.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the axis header, the carets and a span's status note.
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the duration column.

## waterfall.ts

### `interface WaterfallItem`

One row of a waterfall, with its nested spans underneath it.

- `start` :: Start of the span, in the same unit as `duration` (ms, usually).

### `interface WaterfallMarker`

A vertical marker on the timeline (a deploy, an event).

### `interface WaterfallRow`

A row as the template walks it: the item, how deep it sits, and whether it has children.

### `function flattenWaterfall`

The rows to render: parents, then the children of anything in `expanded`.

### `function collectExpandableIds`

Every id that has children, so "expand all" knows what to open.

### `function computeBounds`

The span the timeline covers, including any markers; never empty or inverted.
